Asobi Review 1.0 (build 1606) Oct 15, 2026

  • Rename a shot. In Shots on Disk, click a row and choose Rename to give its shot another number: its plates, records, frame maps, proxies, source_info.txt, .metadata.json, plate review movies and folder, and the sequence’s list of names. A number another shot has, or had, is refused.
  • Written down first. Every step is recorded in the job’s 00_ADMIN/_RENAMES before anything moves, and Undo Last Rename puts it all back. Work under work/ and renders/ is listed, with the scripts that point at the old path, and never changed; Kitsu still calls the shot by its old number.
  • Fixed: a shot whose PL holds two clips (a plate pulled again from another clip) keeps its other PLs and isn’t pulled again for nothing.
Earlier updates

1.0 (build 1476) Oct 12, 2026

  • DPX sequences play. 8, 10, 12 and 16-bit DPX files open and play like any other image sequence, read as the color space set for DPX in Settings, Color.
  • A tall floating Playlist with thumbnails could stop the app. Fixed.
  • Small fixes.

1.0 (build 1441) Oct 11, 2026

  • Network is in the Review menu. Review ▸ Network; it was under Window. It is also in the right-click Review menu.
  • A playlist on a network drive no longer slows the window. Whether each clip's file is there is checked in the background.
  • Locate Media… reads a folder in the background. A line above the toolbar says how far it has got.

Asobi Review 1.0 (build 1604) Oct 15, 2026

  • Shots on Disk. Media ▸ Shots on Disk lists every version folder of the cut’s sequence, in a window that can join the others as a tab: what is written about it (Asobi, vfx edit, Adopted, or nothing), what the cut on screen says of its shot, and whether its frames agree with that paperwork. Nothing in it changes anything on disk.
  • Verify Paperwork. Each folder’s frames are checked against their record or source_info.txt line: frame 1001 against the line’s Source TC, a record’s first frame against its timecode, a vfx edit line against the cut. A frame out reads “Off by 2 against its line”; missing frames, two names in one folder and a PL written for more than one clip are listed too.
  • Filter by Needs Attention, Orphans, Not in This Cut or With Notes, or search by shot, plate or problem; Orphaned Plates… opens from there.

Asobi Review 1.0 (build 1602) Oct 15, 2026

  • The Orphaned Plates window. Every orphaned plate of the cut’s sequence in one table, in a window of its own that can join Conform, Pull Plates and Queue as a tab (Media ▸ Orphaned Plates, or the Orphans row). Each version folder is placed in the cut by its frames’ timecode, with how well it fits: Exact when frame 1001 is the cut’s first frame, or how far off it is.
  • Search and filter the list by shot, clip or fit, and show All, Ticked, Ready to Adopt, Exact, Off or Not Placed. Adopt and Set Aside act on the ticked rows shown, after saying what they will do; Pictures compares a row’s frame with the cut’s.
  • Adopt writes what is on disk. A plate in another PL than the cut stacks its clip as is adopted as it is, and the row says so. Nothing on disk is renamed.
  • Fixed: a shot whose PL01 was pulled again from another clip was taken for the next shot that uses that clip. Every clip a shot’s PL01 has held now counts, and the frames in common decide.
